description: Build a compact, task-scoped prompt for a worker agent. Call once per delegated subtask, then pass only the returned brief using the host's isolated/no-history mode when available. The brief includes the objective, success criteria, relevant project facts and paths, watch-outs, and verification under a bounded token target.

deliverable.description: The exact result the worker should return.

focus_paths.description: Known files or folders the worker should prioritize.

project_id.description: Optional project override. Omit to use the active project for this codebase.

role.description: Optional worker role, such as researcher, implementer, reviewer, or tester.

task.description: The concrete, bounded objective delegated to the worker.

verification.description: Commands or checks the worker should perform.

name: build_subagent_brief
